text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan… here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines? That's—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I actually bought it in secret. 
… But I'm happy.
That I can finally give it to you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it doesn't suit you. 
It's okay to like what you like.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …… Will you accept this, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines………

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
…… Yes. Yes,
thank you…… for giving me the courage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …… Hey? Could you…… clip it on for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ……! …… Sure!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …… Can I fiddle with your hair too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …… Sure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Ines runs her hand along the side of my
head. 
Her fingers feel cool as she touches my
forehead.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(It tickles when the wind blows,
and an unfamiliar 
rustle reaches my ear from closeby.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: … H-How does it look?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Wait, I'll take a picture for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: … Okay.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gimme a smile… and snap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: … Have a look, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It looks good on you. Really. Super cute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? … Thanks. 
……――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Suddenly,
inadvertently… I was struck by the thought
that 
Ines looked as cool as a manga character a
few minutes ago…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Ahh, so that's it, I thought. 
…… Yeah. That's what I admired.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(How I wanted to be like.
What I wanted to do with the café…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why she gave her a small push, 
gently trying to bring out her courage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (I'm sure of it. I always wanted to be like Master.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(To be able to give someone a push when they
couldn't 
muster the courage to take that final
step.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (…… Just like you did earlier.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …… I'm no match for you, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ? What's up, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
…… Listen,
there's something I want to talk to you
about. 
The café's concept… I want to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
―― I want to reiterate the café's concept
as 
"giving someone a spoonful of courage".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When you're lost or nervous and can't take
that step forwards, we can encourage you,
provide that little push in the back. 
… I thought it would be nice to have a café
like that.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uoooh…! Yeah, that sounds great! 
So? What should we do?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
I haven't thought of anything specific… 
I wanted to ask you.
Does anyone have any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, yes! I dooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we make a tooooooooon of marvelous
chocos?☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A choco for every customer! 
Each one made specifically for them☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own unique tastes and
feelings☆ 
So layer them all into the choco★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You can give them to someone☆ 
Or just as a present to yourself when you
lack courage★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's exciting from the moment it's in your
hands! 
Like a push in the back,
setting you off on a marvelous dash!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Let's make chocos like that☆★

text_block_list.name: All 4
text_block_list.text: Oohhh～～…!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nice, nice!! That's a super nice idea!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think so too! Thanks, Marvelous. 
Let's go straight to the owner!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
…… Okay,
I need to get myself together too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines,
a moment?
… Can you clip the flower on again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to wear it in front of customers this
time. 
So… I want you to make me look cute.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ――! Sure!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: Haaah～… Should I give him chocolates～? What'll I do if he doesn't want them……

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, how wishy-washy can you be? But a'ight,
that's 
why I brought you here I guess.
Heard courage comes 
in cups or something—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Are you two next? There's seats available!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Welcome! To our café!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text: Whoa… A mountain of chocolate……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, eye-catching, isn't it? Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Since it's that time of year… we prepared
some chocolate to 
give you the courage to be honest about your
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not… very good at being honest either.
I dearly 
understand the feeling of being so close
but not being 
able to make up your mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
… But if you work up the courage to face
your feelings 
there's a whole new future waiting for
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And we will gladly help you with that.
Let us serve you the last 
ounce of courage you need to take a step
forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You'll certainly find your very own chocolate
in there. 
Each one made to support someone's unique
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So please tell me.
What kind of chocolate do you require?
